# Openings summary (`openings-summary`)

Open doors and windows counted and listed, with a warning tone when something should be shut.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createOpeningsSummary` (types in `dist/web/home/security/openingsSummary.d.ts`): `section.mh-openings-summary`: a `__header` (`__icon`, `__title` heading and the polite `__count`, "3 open" or"All shut"), an optional `__reason`, and the `__list` of open items, the ones that should be shut first(`__item.is-alert` with a `__flag`), each a `__row` (a `<button>` with `onSelect`) with `__item-icon`, `__name`and `__meta`. States `.is-warning` (something should be shut) and `.is-clear` (nothing open).

```ts
export function createOpeningsSummary(options: OpeningsSummaryOptions): OpeningsSummaryHandle;

export interface OpeningsSummaryOptions {
  items: readonly OpeningEntry[];
  /** Why something should be shut ("Rain expected within the hour"); shown in the warning tone. */
  reason?: string | null;
  /** The warning tone even without an alerting item. */
  warning?: boolean;
  /** List closed items too, after the open ones. */
  showClosed?: boolean;
  /** Level of the title heading (default 3). */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;
  labels?: Partial<OpeningsSummaryLabels>;
  /** Makes each item a button. */
  onSelect?: (id: string) => void;
}

export interface OpeningsSummaryHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  update(changes: Partial<OpeningsSummaryOptions>): void;
}

export interface OpeningEntry {
  id: string;
  /** "Back door", "Bathroom window". */
  name: string;
  kind?: OpeningKind;
  open: boolean;
  /** Where it is ("Kitchen"). */
  area?: string;
  /** How long it has been open, as the app words it ("20 min"). */
  since?: string;
  /** It should be shut now (rain on the way, the alarm is armed, nobody home): takes the warning tone. */
  alert?: boolean;
}

export interface OpeningsSummaryLabels {
  title: string;
  /** The count: `{n}` open. */
  open: string;
  /** When nothing is open. */
  allShut: string;
  /** Spoken after an item that should be shut. */
  shouldBeShut: string;
  /** Shown on closed items with `showClosed`. */
  closed: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createOpeningsSummary, type OpeningEntry } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let items: OpeningEntry[] = [
  // Should be shut now: takes the warning tone and goes first.
  { id: 'skylight', name: 'Skylight', kind: 'window', open: true, area: 'Landing', alert: true },
  { id: 'back', name: 'Back door', kind: 'door', open: true, area: 'Kitchen', since: '5 min' },
  { id: 'garage', name: 'Garage door', kind: 'garage', open: false },
];

const summary = createOpeningsSummary({
  items,
  reason: 'Rain expected within the hour',
  onSelect: (id) => {
    items = items.map((item) => (item.id === id ? { ...item, open: false, alert: false } : item));
    summary.update({ items });
  },
});

document.body.append(summary.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { OpeningsSummary } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { OpeningEntry } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const START: OpeningEntry[] = [
  // Should be shut now: takes the warning tone and goes first.
  { id: 'skylight', name: 'Skylight', kind: 'window', open: true, area: 'Landing', alert: true },
  { id: 'back', name: 'Back door', kind: 'door', open: true, area: 'Kitchen', since: '5 min' },
  { id: 'garage', name: 'Garage door', kind: 'garage', open: false },
];

export function OpeningsSummaryExample() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState(START);
  const shut = (id: string) =>
    setItems((all) => all.map((i) => (i.id === id ? { ...i, open: false, alert: false } : i)));
  return <OpeningsSummary items={items} reason="Rain expected within the hour" onSelect={shut} />;
}
```
